preconditions.description: The number of tourist attractions N is between 3 and 20.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly N lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line contains exactly N numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(price) > 0 for line in stdout.splitlines() for price in line.split())
all(int(price) <= 1000 for line in stdout.splitlines() for price in line.split())
postconditions.description: All prices are not greater than 1000.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[i]) == 0 for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()))
all(int(line.split()[j]) == int(stdout.splitlines()[j].split()[i]) for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
len(set(int(price) for line in stdout.splitlines() for price in line.split())) == N * N - N
